question: When did the Hershey-Chase experiment provide solid evidence that DNA, not proteins, is the genetic material?
solution: The correct answer is __**1952**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Hershey-Chase experiment** was conducted in **1952** by Alfred Hershey and Martha Chase, providing conclusive evidence that **DNA** is the genetic material, not proteins. • They worked with **bacteriophages** (viruses that infect bacteria) to determine whether **DNA or protein** carried genetic information. • The experiment involved labeling DNA with **radioactive phosphorus (P-32)** and proteins with **radioactive sulfur (S-35)** to trace their presence after infection of bacterial cells. • After the infection process and separation using a blender, it was observed that **radioactive DNA** entered the bacterial cells, whereas **radioactive protein** remained outside the cells. • This demonstrated that **DNA**, not protein, is responsible for carrying genetic information, revolutionizing molecular biology and genetics.
